crossRefs.note: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied…

people.name: Ahoah
people.line: Descendant of Benjamin, clan of David's mighty men

people.name: Dodo
people.line: Father of Eleazar, one of David's mighty men

people.name: Mikloth
people.line: A military commander during David's reign.

translations.web: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite, and his division; and Mikloth the ruler: and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
translations.bsb: Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the division for the second month, and Mikloth was the leader. There were 24,000 men in his division.
translations.kjv: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
translations.asv: And over the course of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite, and his course; and Mikloth the ruler: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
